title: Hide Concepts From Home App UI
description: Remove all concept-related UI from the Home app: concept chips in table rows (mobile and desktop), concept filtering logic (allConcepts, selectedConcepts, toggleConcept), and the ConceptFilter component. Concepts must never be visible or interactable in the Home app UI.
summary: Removed all concept UI from the Home app and cleaned up dead concept code in the Kit app. Changes in compose/sketchpad/index.tsx: (1) Removed concepts field from HomeTableRow type. (2) Removed allConcepts useMemo, selectedConcepts useMemo, and concept-based kit filtering from HomeTableContent. (3) Removed resolveKitConcepts helper and concepts fields from kit row pushes. (4) Removed toggleConcept function from HomeTableContent. (5) Removed concept chips from both mobile and desktop home table row renderers. (6) Removed getKitSnapshot from HomeTableContent destructuring. (7) Removed concepts field from Kit app TableRow type. (8) Removed designConceptNames computation and concepts field from design row push in allRows. (9) Removed kitConcepts, kitConceptsKey, resolveGuid from Kit app. (10) Removed selectedConcepts URL param read from Kit app. (11) Removed allConcepts useMemo from Kit app. (12) Removed toggleConcept from Kit app. (13) Removed dead selectionMemo block. (14) Removed kitConcepts/kitConceptsKey/selectedConcepts from allRows dependency array. All 105 unit tests pass.
